measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

optional.what: support OAuth integration and installed account operations
optional.setting: Install (2): the workspace Intercom integration creates an installedIntegration; inbound handlers require it (apps/web/app/(ee)/api/intercom/callback/route.ts:115; apps/web/app/(ee)/api/intercom/webhook/process/route.ts:35).

An install: add the non-global Intercom App Store app; getApps omits it without a user credential (packages/app-store/utils.ts:47-56). AppCard offers installation (packages/app-store/_components/AppCard.tsx:94,116), and the OAuth callback creates that credential (packages/app-store/intercom/api/callback.ts:58-63). Catalog metadata availability is separate from a user installation; calendar onboarding does not install Intercom (apps/web/modules/onboarding/personal/calendar/personal-calendar-view.tsx:28-34).
